pages.text: Turing's reaction and diffusion: an activator makes more of itself and of an inhibitor; the inhibitor holds the activator back. If the inhibitor spreads r times as fast as the activator, and r is above a critical value (about 5.8 here), an even mixture is unstable: small bumps grow into stripes and spots, spaced about 2π·r^¼/√k apart for a reaction rate k.
$(thing)Set$(): Spreading ratio, Reaction rate.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): An uneven dish: the critical ratio varies by ±2%·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): No pattern: the inhibitor does not spread fast enough.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Faster reactions are quicker.
